leadText: Masami Iwasaki (Japanese: 岩崎征実 Iwasaki Masami) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Masami Iwasaki (Japanese: 岩崎征実 Iwasaki Masami) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Iwasaki was born on October 25, 1971, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. In Pokémon animation, he first voiced Opelucid City Gym Leader Drayden in Pokémon Generations. He then joined the during , where he voiced Mad Magmar, a member of the antagonistic Revengers. Iwasaki tends to be cast in the roles of minions or ruffians.
